selected_script.angle: Scratching hardened grease spots with fingernails is frustrating; Liapu spray dissolves these stubborn sticky messes instantly for a zero-residue wipe.
selected_script.hook: I was literally trying to scratch this hardened grease off my counter with my fingernail.

script_record.segment_01_vo: I was literally trying to scratch this hardened grease off my counter with my fingernail. It was stuck like glue. Then I finally grabbed this Liapu kitchen spray.
script_record.segment_02_vo: You just spray this heavy-duty degreaser right on the sticky spots, let it sit for a few seconds, and watch it dissolve. One wipe, and the grease is gone.
script_record.segment_03_vo: Look at that. No sticky residue, just a clean lemon scent. Plus, it kills 99.9 percent of bacteria like Salmonella. This is a total game-changer for kitchen messes.
